verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging and diagnostics.

work_dir.description: Base directory for temporary files (e.g., processed depth maps).

output_dir.description: Directory where generated stereograms are saved by default.

output_format.description: Default image format for output (e.g., png, jpeg).

worker_threads.description: Number of parallel worker threads for rendering.

min_depth_res.description: Minimum depth map resolution (in pixels). Smaller = faster, but lower fidelity.

max_depth_res.description: Maximum depth map resolution (in pixels). Larger = more detail, but slower.

auto_depth_scale.description: Automatically adjust depth scale to prevent clipping.

depth_scale.description: Depth scaling factor (0.0–1.0). Controls perceived 3D depth range.

eye_separation.description: Horizontal pixel shift between left/right views (affects depth perception strength).

focal_distance.description: Focal distance (in pixels) — determines where the depth plane appears neutral.

host.description: Hostname or IP to bind the GUI/web server to.

auto_open_browser.description: Automatically open the default web browser on startup.

api_secret.description: Secret for API authentication (empty = no auth).

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed CORS origins (for web-based clients).

filters.description: Ordered list of optional pre-rendering filters for depth maps.

local_only.description: Only allow local files as input (no remote URLs). Prevents SSRF.

max_input_pixels_mpx.description: Maximum input image size in megapixels. Larger images are rejected.
